1. (Currently Amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, __wherein the housing includes a front cover that is removable to provide access to internal components of the cooling system__.

2. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced __sixteen__ inches on center.

3. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced about twenty-four inches on center.

4. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad__, and wherein the water distributor includes a plurality of distribution holes for uniform water distribution__.

5. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation__, and wherein the motor drives the fan at a variable speed__.

6. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening__, wherein the opening is positioned to direct cooled air into an interior space of the structure__.

7. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation__, and wherein the housing includes a collection tray positioned below the pad to collect water for recirculation__.

8. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the water reservoir is filled with additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below a predetermined level.

9. (Original) The cooling system of claim 8, further including a ball float valve that opens to fill the water reservoir with the additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below the predetermined level.

10. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, further including a water drain.

11. (Cancelled)

12. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.

13. (Cancelled)

14. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the structure is a garage.

15. (Cancelled)

16. (Original) The cooling system kit of claim 15, further including instructions.

17. (Currently Amended) A cooling system, comprising: __a housing configured for mounting__ within a structure wall, __an evaporative cooling assembly positioned within the housing and configured to evaporatively cool__ an indoor area.

18. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein __the housing is configured for mounting by placing the evaporative cooling assembly__ between wall studs spaced __sixteen__ inches on center.

19. (Original) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF).

20. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein __the housing__ protrudes from the wall less than three inches.
